text.offer: Pritchett says, "Welcome to the Royal City. If you mean to come back, and everyone does, touch the city's portal before you leave. It stands at the north-west corner of the north town. Walk into it and it'll know you, and you can step back here from any other portal you've touched."
text.complete: Pritchett says, "There. The Royal City is always a step away now. Stay a night or two next time, won't you?"

steps.brief: Barloque's travel portal stands at the north-west corner of the north town (a gold "!" marks portals you haven't touched). Walk into it to attune yourself to it.
